name: Bramblewick Bakehouse
one_liner: A neighborhood sourdough bakery that teaches small, hands-on weekend bread classes.
audience: Home bakers and curious beginners within 20 minutes of the shop who want a relaxed, social way to learn real bread.
do: Create urgency: tell people seats are almost gone and they must book today
Lead with a bold promise, for example: Results guaranteed after one class
Say we are better than the other bakeries nearby
Shout the offer in capital letters
goal: Drive signups for the Saturday beginner sourdough class.
